title: R.M.D. Chamarbaugwalla v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: R.M.D. Chamarbaugwalla v. Union of India, AIR 1957 SC 628
content.holding: Laid down the definitive seven rules of severability; severed prize competitions involving skill from gambling competitions under the Prize Competitions Act 1955.
content.relevance: Locus classicus on Doctrine of Severability in India.
